# ascetic

> abstinent or austere in lifestyle (adj); a person who leads an austere and simple life without material pleasures, esp. someone who does this for religious reasons

> 1. (of a lifestyle) very strict and lacking luxury
> 2. someone who adopts an ascetic lifestyle


## Example

- *His ascetic life is the main reason he inspired so many followers, especially since he gave up wealth and power to live in poverty.*
